reading.title: Muscles and skin features
reading.text: Dina reads muscle names in an anatomy guide. Pectoral refers to the chest, while abdominal refers to the abdomen. Trapezius and latissimus name back muscles. The rotator cuff is a shoulder muscle-and-tendon group. Core is a broad term for trunk muscles. Dina then reads tendon, skin, pore, freckle, mole and birthmark. She learns the names without deciding whether a skin mark is healthy or harmful.

reading.title: Skin marks and sun exposure words
reading.text: Dina reads a skin vocabulary page. A scar is a mark after an injury heals. A wrinkle is a line or fold. Goosebumps are small raised bumps that may occur with cold or emotion. Tan means darkening after sun exposure, while sunburn is UV-related skin damage. Dina identifies the terms from descriptions. The page does not recommend tanning or diagnose a person's skin from its color.
